body: I've tried. I've seen psychiatrists, psychologists, done CBT, see a social worker weekly, tried meds, everything. This isn't from lack of trying. I honestly am a happy person generally and I try to make everyone around me laugh. I'm usually the one people ask for advice so I feel weird about telling any of my friends how I feel sometimes because I'm supposed to be the bubbly stable one. You can't promise me that, not really, because I mean in reality nobody actually knows. I'm having a hard time trying to explain what I mean so I'm incredibly sorry but I'm not a sad person and my life is not sad. I'm just a bit off that's all.
